aggregation.metrics: Arithmetic mean of defined fold ECEs; never ECE of the averaged curve.
aggregation.coverage: Equal weight per nonempty fold at each common coverage level.
aggregation.pair_curve: Equal weight per fold with pairs in the bin; undefined bins stay empty.
aggregation.pair_counts: Sum of within-fold pairs; no pairs across folds.
aggregation.error_metrics: Equal-fold ENCE and uncertainty CV; annotations use ±2 sample fold SD.
aggregation.error_curve: Prefer training-standardized RMV/RMSE; average only matching full quantile grids.
aggregation.error_bars: Sample standard deviation across contributing folds (ddof=1); not a confidence interval.
